tagline: A bodyguard duo — Newt powers your turns, and Ripley answers anyone who gets near her

featuredCards.title: M41A Pulse RIFLE
featuredCards.caption: Your engine while Newt stands: every space between Ripley and the target is +1 to the shot — distance is ammunition.

featuredCards.title: GET BEHIND ME
featuredCards.caption: The bodyguard move — mid-combat, Ripley and Newt swap spaces and Ripley becomes the defender instead.

featuredCards.title: M41A GRENADE LAUNCHER
featuredCards.caption: When they bunch up in your zone, clear the room — 2 damage on the target and splash on everyone beside them.

featuredCards.title: GET AWAY FROM HER, YOU *****!
featuredCards.caption: The line, as a finisher — it only boosts when they made the mistake of standing next to Newt.
